approved: Commonwealth Electoral Amendment (Real Time Disclosure of Political Donations) Bill 2019
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would make political donation reporting happen faster.
Party officials would have to tell the Australian Electoral Commission about donations of $13,800 or more within five business days of receiving them.
The bill does not change the $13,800 threshold or alter election or by-election rules.
The bill requires agents or financial controllers to report donations that meet or exceed the disclosure threshold.
The bill sets a five-business-day deadline for reporting each donation.
The bill does not change the disclosure threshold or election arrangements.
Political parties, their branches, and campaigners who receive donations.
